title: ELK75
body:
First of all this app is not for free, I’d rather use Gemini that is totally free. Second of all it limited with language, I want my AI in Norwegian, and that Gemini can provide, even ChatGPT and Siri comes in Norwegian. With Siri AI I can do everything this app that you have to pay for for free. All you have to do is say "hey Siri" set an alarm for date and time, make a task list, and it has one of the best sleep schedules option ever.


Another thing is that it repeats stupid question and doesn’t get what a person answers when your things things up, with Siri it’s much easier, especially since it has Norwegian language, I think a language barrier worldwide will be a problematic for this app except for the language that already is there.


This app is more frustrating than using paper notes to remember stuff. And it’s too complicated for an ADHD person (except maybe a computer/digital wise ADHD person with OCD) to use in daily life. And you have to set up everything, which makes it more frustrating that you have to sit and put in every detail you need to have or want to do or something for just getting some little help.

My advice is to stay clear of this app until it can reach the level of Gemini & Siri
author: Kozoll75

title: Don’t waist you’r money!
body: This app does not have a free verson! You need to pay, to use it! I will rather use Gemini than this app! Stay clear unless you have money to waste, there isnt even a free trail period. You need to pay alot from the start.
author: gb-1991

title: Waste of time and money
body: So many good reviews on TikTok. So my impulsivity that comes with adhd desperately payed for it. But literally just wasted 40$. Conversations are repetitive and the AI keeps asking the same questions i already answered 3+ times, which only makes you more frustrated and lost in what to do. Chat GPT is free and so much better.
